site.sitedescription: Four small inflows in the southwest and one outflow in the north. There are stands of Alnus glutinosa and Fraxinus excelsior along the lake shore. The flat areas around the lake are intensivley used for agriculture. The earliest archaeological findings date back to ca. 15,000 cal BP (hunter camp at Fürsteiner). Several Neolithic lake-shore settlements.
